text: The robot successfully delivered 0 out of 336 orders within the given period, averaging 36 seconds per order but with a median time of just 5 seconds. The top failure reason was "unknown" (113 times), affecting orders such as [cite:7] and [cite:29]. Slowest orders often involved t-shirts, taking up to 2622 seconds. Given the high frequency of unknown failures, it's crucial to ensure clear communication channels between ROBI and staff for immediate [[intervention]] in case of unexpected issues.
